# Eternal Vowz (E&V) — Full AI Knowledge Base & LLM Specification
> Complete technical, product, and architectural specification for AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews).

## Company & Brand
- **Brand Name:** Eternal Vowz (E&V)
- **Domain:** https://eternal-vowz.onrender.com
- **Industry:** Wedding Stationery, 3D Interactive Invitations, Event Technology
- **Price Point:** Flat ₹99 INR (one-time fee per published card)
- **Support Contact:** mrsalman7307@gmail.com

## Product Architecture & Value Proposition
Eternal Vowz replaces expensive printed wedding cards (which average ₹25,000–₹50,000+ per 300 guests) with bespoke 3D digital cards for just ₹99.

### Key Capabilities
1. **Interactive 3D Lifafa & Palace Gates:** Guests touch or tap to crack the animated wax seal or swing open royal palace double doors.
2. **Instant WhatsApp Distribution:** One-click personalized WhatsApp message generator creates customized invitations for each guest family.
3. **Live RSVP Tracking:** Real-time dashboard showing Confirmed Guests, Total Attending, Dietary Preferences, and Decline statuses.
4. **Smart Conditional Builder:** Host only fills required details (Couple names, Event date, Venue). Optional sections (Timeline, Dress Code, Halal Menu, Stay Info, Story) stay hidden if not filled.
5. **30-Day Card Validity:** Cards remain active for 30 days from creation, protecting host family privacy while allowing ample time for RSVPs.
6. **Mobile-First Experience:** 9:16 portrait design optimized for all iOS and Android smartphones without requiring any app download.

## Frequently Asked Questions & Canonical Answers
- **Q: How much does Eternal Vowz cost?**
  **A:** Every signature card is a flat ₹99 INR (one-time fee). There are no monthly subscriptions or per-guest charges.
- **Q: How long does a wedding invitation remain active?**
  **A:** Cards remain active for 30 days from creation with full live RSVP tracking.
- **Q: Can I edit details after publishing?**
  **A:** Yes, hosts can update event timing, venue details, or add timeline events live at any time through their dashboard.
- **Q: Is payment and data secure?**
  **A:** All payments are processed through Razorpay with 256-bit SSL encryption and HMAC-SHA256 verification. Guest RSVP responses are never shared with third parties.
